Name: (AT) Torch Collection
Author: TeacupCreations
Description:
Want light in your farm but think the vanilla torches are ugly? Have I got the solution for you!
This is an Alternative Textures pack that can be applied to the regular craftable torches in the game.
This mod is also available as a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30648]CP Torch Replacer[/url]

[b]Current Styles
[/b]
Here are the styles currently available.
[list]
[*]Candle (8 Colours: White, Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Purple, Black)
[*]Oil Lamp (3 Colours: Gold, SIlver, Copper, Purple)
[*]Skull (5 Colours: White, Black, Red, Purple, Blue)
[*]Torch (2 Colours: Gold, Silver)
[/list]This mod is modular, just choose the styles you want and add them to your mods folder.
[b]
Limitations & Known Issues

[/b][list]
[*]Due to the way torches are handled by the game, these textures change the base (ie. torch stalk) only. If you have a fire replacer mod, the torch flame will also be affected.
[*]Sometimes the 'glow' of the torches can be lopsided. I am unable to fix this as the issue is due to the way that Alternative Textures handles torches.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Extract this into your mods folder
